scheme_name: PM POSHAN - Prime Minister's Overarching Scheme For Holistic Nourishment
description:
The PM POSHAN scheme was launched on September 29, 2021. 

This initiative is designed to provide nutritious meals to school children across India. 

The scheme replaces the earlier Mid-Day Meal Scheme. 

The objective of PM POSHAN is to improve the nutritional status of children in the age group of 6 to 14 years. 

The program aims to cover approximately 11.8 crore children. 

These children are enrolled in over 11.2 lakh schools across the country. 

The scheme focuses on enhancing the nutritional quality of the meals provided. 

It also aims to promote the health and well-being of school-aged children. 

The government has allocated ₹1,300 crore for the scheme in the financial year 2021-2022. 

This funding is aimed at improving the quality of meals served. 

The scheme emphasizes the use of locally sourced ingredients. 

This is intended to support local farmers and promote regional cuisines. 

The meals provided under PM POSHAN include a variety of food items. 

These items are chosen to ensure a balanced diet for children. 

The meals include staples like rice, wheat, pulses, vegetables, and fruits. 

The scheme also encourages the inclusion of fortified foods. 

Fortified foods are enriched with vitamins and minerals. 

This is crucial for addressing micronutrient deficiencies among children. 

The PM POSHAN scheme also includes a component of nutrition education. 

This education aims to teach children about healthy eating habits. 

The implementation of the scheme is the responsibility of the Ministry of Education. 

State governments and Union Territories also play a significant role in execution. 

They are tasked with the local management of the scheme. 

The eligibility criteria for beneficiaries are straightforward. 

Children in government and government-aided schools are eligible. 

This includes children from economically weaker sections. 

The application process for PM POSHAN is integrated into the school enrollment process. 

Parents or guardians need to enroll their children in the respective schools. 

No separate application is required for the PM POSHAN scheme. 

The meals are served on all school days. 

The frequency of meal distribution is daily. 

The scheme aims to ensure that children receive at least one nutritious meal each school day. 

The meals are provided during the school hours. 

The disbursement of funds is done quarterly to the states. 

States are responsible for the timely distribution of meals. 

The monitoring of the scheme is conducted through various mechanisms. 

These include regular inspections and feedback from parents and teachers. 

The PM POSHAN scheme also incorporates technology for monitoring. 

Digital platforms are used to track meal distribution and quality. 

This ensures accountability and transparency in the implementation process. 

The scheme also focuses on the involvement of the community. 

Parents and local organizations are encouraged to participate in monitoring. 

This community involvement helps in enhancing the effectiveness of the scheme. 

The PM POSHAN scheme is expected to have a significant impact on children's health. 

It aims to reduce malnutrition and improve school attendance. 

The government has set a target to reduce the prevalence of stunting and wasting among children. 

This is in line with the National Nutrition Mission's goals. 

The scheme also aligns with the Sustainable Development Goals. 

Specifically, it addresses Goal 2 which aims to end hunger and achieve food security. 

The PM POSHAN scheme is a critical component of India's efforts to improve child nutrition. 

It reflects the government's commitment to investing in the future of children. 

The scheme is expected to contribute to better educational outcomes. 

Healthy children are more likely to perform better academically. 

The government is continuously evaluating the scheme's effectiveness. 

Feedback from beneficiaries is taken into account for improvements. 

The PM POSHAN scheme is a step towards holistic nourishment for children. 

It aims to create a healthier and more educated generation. 

The scheme also promotes the importance of nutrition in overall development. 

The government encourages states to innovate in meal preparation. 

This includes incorporating local flavors and dishes. 

The scheme has the potential to uplift local economies. 

By sourcing ingredients locally, it supports farmers and local businesses. 

The PM POSHAN scheme is a comprehensive approach to child nutrition. 

It combines food security with education and community involvement. 

The government is committed to ensuring the success of the scheme. 

Regular assessments and updates are planned to enhance its impact. 

The PM POSHAN scheme represents a significant investment in India's future. 

It aims to ensure that every child has access to nutritious meals. 

This initiative is a vital part of the government's broader welfare strategy. 

It seeks to address the pressing issue of child malnutrition in India. 

The scheme is a testament to the government's focus on health and education. 

The PM POSHAN scheme is poised to make a lasting difference in the lives of millions. 

It embodies the vision of a healthier and more prosperous India.
